content:
marta: Posted a fresh draft of the launch post in Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/launchsprint/draft-v3. Main asks: tighten hero, add explicit benchmark context, and include the demo-seat flow under the CTA. Can we do a quick sweep before EOD?

alex: Thanks — I did a first pass. Couple of callouts: the benchmark currently lists only p50/p95 numbers. We should say what workload that is (chat w/ streaming + 2.5k token prefix). Also we need the HubSpot wiring snippet so ops can pre-provision webhooks.

sam: I rewrote the benchmark paragraph suggestion: "In a mixed chat + long-context streaming workload (avg conv length ~800 tokens, intermittent system messages), Redwood achieves ~32% lower per-token compute compared to the baseline using prefix KV caching and adaptive batching (run ID run_2026_03_20_v9)." Happy to change to a range if legal prefers.

kasia: Please don't publish a single-point number without the run link and the CSV. Legal will likely ask for conservative language. If you include run_2026_03_20_v9, attach CSV or a link to the eval bucket.

sam: CSV link: s3://redwood-evals/2026/03/20/run_v9/metrics.csv. Snippet: ```workload: chat+stream
avg_context: 800
per_token_compute_ratio: 0.68```

kasia: OK. Recommend phrasing: "~3005%" (typo intentionally avoid) — wait, that looks odd; better: "approximately 3005%". Also need the claim sign-off checklist filled out in the doc.

marta: Editorially, let's avoid words like "game-changing" or "breakthrough." Use "notable latency improvements" or similar. Also move the FAQ about demo seats higher on the page.

jenni: Webinar details: Thu 2026-04-08 10:00 PT. Webinar cap 300. Ops reserved 60 demo seats for demand gen. Request from demand gen: for the first 24 hours after publish, enterprise-tagged leads get 3 demo seats allocated; after 24h it falls back to 1 seat. Need clear language in the blog on how demo seats are distributed.

oliver: Ops note: seat allocation script is ready but needs the HubSpot form ID + property that marks enterprise. Share mapping and we can test webhook routing tomorrow.

sam: Proposed HubSpot mapping block (add to post under Integration appendix): ```hubspot_form_id: hs_992233
properties:
  email: contact.email
  company: contact.company
  lead_tier: single_select (enterprise, startup, other)
  campaign: product_announce_apr2026
webhook: https://hooks.redwood.com/hs/webhooks/announce-2026```

ops-bot: automated-check: webhook reachable, content-type application/json, test event accepted (200 OK).

kasia: Legal checklist: include data residency note (EU leads -> EU HubSpot instance), retention period, and a short sentence on processing. Suggest: "Lead contact data (email, company) will be retained for 18 months for outreach and product updates; EU leads are stored in our EU region HubSpot instance."

legal-bot: automated-scan: email/company only, no sensitive PII detected. Please confirm retention period with Privacy before publish.

marta: For the hero CTA copy options I drafted three variants: 1) "Join the product launch webinar — demo seats limited" 2) "Register to see the product in action and request a demo" 3) "Save your spot for launch + optional demo booking" Which do folks prefer?

alex: Leaning to #2 (clear value + demo). Shorten to: "Register to see it in action and request a demo."

jenni: If we use #2 we need the microcopy under the CTA explaining demo assignment: "Requesting a demo does not guarantee a demo seat. Demo seats are assigned based on company size and time of request. Enterprise leads in the first 24 hours receive priority." Put the full distribution rules in the FAQ.

sam: I'll update the blog language to use "~3005%" as legal suggested unless privacy pushes back.

kasia: I'll try to get privacy confirmation on 18 months retention by Friday noon. If they push back, we'll default to 12 months.

oliver: I'll run a dry webhook test tomorrow and paste a trace into the doc. Also will attach the seat assignment pseudo-code for transparency: ```if lead_tier == 'enterprise' and publish_age_hours < 24: seats_allocated = 3 elif lead_tier == 'enterprise': seats_allocated = 1 elif lead_tier == 'startup': seats_allocated = 1 else: seats_allocated = 0```

marta: Great. Timeline check: editorial sign-off by Thu EOD, ops + webhook test by Fri 10am PT, legal + privacy by Fri noon, publish Mon AM. Everyone ack?

sam: Ack 023: will paste final benchmark sentence and run link by Thu noon.

alex: Ack 023: will consolidate CTA copies and final HubSpot snippet.

jenni: Ack: will confirm webinar seat counts and dry run invite list.

kasia: Ack: will chase Privacy and update the claim sign-off checklist.

ops-bot: reminder scheduled: webhook test window Thu 9-10am PT.

marta: Thanks all. I'll rework opener and push the hero CTA variants into the doc. Ping here when done and I'll lock for final review.
